## resolveGovernanceForRequest() function

Resolve the governance context for a single call from the authenticated API key.

This is the per-caller half of governance resolution. It is a named, shared seam because "which policy applies to this caller" must be answered the same way by every surface that enforces governance.

The whole context is carried through, not just the policy, so an approval gate configured on the surface reaches the call untouched.

A resolver failure propagates to the caller, which must fail the call closed: an unreadable key policy is \*not\* the same as no key policy, and treating it as such would silently widen the boundary back to the host policy.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function resolveGovernanceForRequest(
  governance: GovernanceContext,
  apiKeyId: string
): Promise<ResolvedGovernanceContext>
```
